gate: Phase 2 — cost model: current (eager, compute-once+reuse) vs per-visit recompute

storage_cost.note: eager buffers (points_xy_image, conic_opacity, features) ALREADY exist in canonical design; no NEW storage for compute-once (it IS the current design).

synchronization_cost.note: canonical pipeline already has a global barrier between preprocess and render (implicit via kernel boundary + radix sort). A compute-once cache adds no NEW sync; a per-visit recompute would also need none. Sync-neutral.

cache_pressure.note: render already stages per-tile batches through shared memory (collected_xy/collected_conic_opacity, BLOCK_SIZE). Eager reuse REDUCES global traffic vs per-visit recompute (which would re-read scale/rot/shs per visit). Cache pressure is LOWER in the current eager design.
